title: Probe-Generalization Benchmark: Measuring Activation Probe Transfer Across Task Contexts

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying probe generalization failure is a prerequisite for improving probes. If probes do not transfer, current optimism about activation-based monitoring is premature. Clear link between measurement and research direction.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires loading Llama-3-8B, extracting activations from intermediate layers, training linear probes, and understanding ControlArena internals. Even with medium compute (single GPU), managing activation extraction pipelines is non-trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Core experiment (train probe in one setting, test in another) is conceptually simple, but setup overhead is high: model loading, activation extraction, probe training across multiple settings, and layer-by-layer analysis. 30 hours is tight.
